docs.text: NWS has issued a low water and gale warning for the Western basin of Lake Erie. I noticed at the ramp that the water level is at least a foot and a half down in the Marina. Must be a Seiche at the Eastern end 😮 Not seeing ships at anchor out there yet.

Heads up: A low water advisory has been issued for western Lake Erie through 7am Wednesday. A southwest wind of 15-25 kts (gusting past 30 kts) will drop lake levels close to 18" below low water datum overnight, and will also whip up some 3-6 ft waves by dawn. #LakeErie #weather
